# Default menu shortcuts

The File menu's and Edit menu's actions and their shortcuts, as they are until the
settings file's `[menu_bar]` changes them.

## File

| Item | Shortcut | Action |
|---|---|---|
| New Folder | `⇧⌘N` | `new-folder` |
| Rename | `F2` | `rename` |
| Batch Rename… | `⇧F2` | `batch-rename` |
| Copy to Other Side | `F5` | `copy-to-other-side` |
| Move to Other Side | `F6` | `move-to-other-side` |
| Reveal in Finder | `⌥⌘R` | `reveal-in-finder` |
| Calculate Folder Sizes | `⌥⌘S` | `folder-sizes` |
| Eject | `⌘E` | `eject` |
| Compare Files | `⌥⌘D` | `compare-files` |
| Compare Folders | `⌥⇧⌘D` | `compare-folders` |
| Move to Trash | `⌘⌫` | `move-to-trash` |
| Delete Immediately | `⌥⌘⌫` | `delete-immediately` |
| Delete Immediately Without Asking | `⌥⇧⌘⌫` | `delete-immediately-without-asking` (while the extra key is held) |

## Edit

| Item | Shortcut | Action |
|---|---|---|
| Copy Path | `⌥⌘C` | `copy-path` |
| Copy Name | `⌥⇧⌘C` | `copy-name` |
